sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Multilingual Customer Inbound Helpdesk and Outbound Tele-Sales BPO

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (Unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-national tax differentiation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between Samoa and Australia (in force)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA) between Samoa and New Zealand (in force)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus); Samoa is a Contracting Party; agreement in force from 13 December 2020
Framework Agreement between the Independent State of Samoa and the People's Republic of China on Economic and Technical Cooperation (investment facilitation framework)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (Samoa), as amended, administered by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; International Companies Act 2013 (No. 12 of 2013), as amended, administered by the International Companies Division of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL); United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargoes and Travel Ban) Act 2014 (Samoa); AML/CFT Guidance Notes issued by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit; FATF Recommendations 10 and 24 as adopted in Samoa's national AML/CFT framework.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner (identity verification)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or notary public of the UBO's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing jurisdiction is a party to the Hague Apostille Convention (including the PRC from 7 November 2023); otherwise Consular Legalization via the Samoan Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each ultimate beneficial owner (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed commercial bank in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; bank statements may bear the bank's sealed confirmation in lieu of notarization where accepted by the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds and source of wealth for the formation capital and initial working capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing licensed commercial bank in the UBO's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; alternatively the bank's original signed letterhead confirmation subject to direct verification by the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extract of the corporate register and certificate of good standing of any intermediate legal-entity UBO in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the intermediate entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization as applicable to the issuing jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Chinese corporate documents: business licence, articles of association, and board resolution approving the Samoa International Company formation (PRC corporate UBO scenario)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PRC notary public (公证处) together with the certified seal of the local Administration for Market Regulation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs Apostille under the Hague Apostille Convention (in force for the PRC since 7 November 2023) plus certified English translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed UBO declaration and due diligence questionnaire for each ultimate beneficial owner, witnessed before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the UBO's jurisdiction plus the licensed Samoa registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where executed outside Samoa; Consular Legalization where the execution jurisdiction is not an Apostille party

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders holding 10% or more, and authorised signatories against: (i) the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (ii) the OFAC SDN and consolidated non-SDN lists; (iii) the EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists; (iv) Samoa's domestically designated persons under the United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargoes and Travel Ban) Act 2014; and (v) adverse media and negative news sources. Any Politically Exposed Person (PEP) status, whether domestic or foreign, triggers enhanced due diligence requiring written source of wealth and source of funds evidence, approval at the registered agent's compliance officer level, and ongoing transaction monitoring; relatives and close associates of PEPs are treated as PEPs in accordance with the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) and FIU Guidance Notes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry - International Companies Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia; name clearance and reservation applications are lodged by the licensed registered agent through the MCIL corporate registry lodgement channel.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory filings and the registered company name must be in English using the Latin alphabet. A Chinese-language charter is permissible as a certified translation appended to the English charter for family-governance and record-keeping purposes, but the English text prevails for statutory interpretation. A Chinese trading name may be adopted for operational billing and call-center branding, but it must not appear in registered instruments without an English transliteration; the registry does not accept Chinese characters as the primary registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating grounds, furnishing distinguishing evidence, and, where the ground concerns a sensitive token, attaching a letter of no-objection from the relevant supervisory authority (e.g., Central Bank of Samoa for banking or insurance tokens; MCIL for cooperative or foundation tokens). If the Registrar affirms the rejection, the applicant may refer the matter to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour for final administrative determination within 21 days. A modified-name re-filing may proceed in parallel without prejudice. Judicial review is not required at Stage 1 and is expressly deferred until after incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as a statutory registered office. Every Samoa International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the premises of an MCIL-licensed registered agent, where the statutory records, share register, and beneficial ownership records must remain available for inspection. The offshore BPO operations (remote multilingual helpdesk and outbound tele-sales infrastructure) may be hosted entirely outside Samoa on cloud-based platforms; a virtual office may be used only for non-statutory operational correspondence and must not be held out as the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for a Standard Low-Risk BPO entity: approximately 10% baseline probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit or the Registrar of International Companies within the first 36 months. The risk rises to approximately 35% if UBO verification files are incomplete, PEP or sanctions screening gaps are identified, or the registered agent's own AML compliance audit is rated deficient.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search, clearance, and priority name reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: International Companies Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per MCIL International Companies Registry fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO identification and verification file compilation per UBO (KYC forms, verification calls, document provenance checks)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoa registered agent (MCIL-licensed corporate services provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed registered agents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening per UBO plus consolidated entity screening report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent's compliance team via commercial screening database subscriptions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for commercial sanctions-screening subscriptions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille (Hague Convention) of UBO identity, address, and source-of-funds documentation bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public of origin jurisdiction and Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Apostille Office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff plus prevailing apostille service fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of Chinese-language corporate and identity documents (PRC UBO scenario)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn certified translator (English-Chinese) verified by the licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for certified sworn translation services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence opinion covering entity structure, AML/CFT exposure, and tax-exempt status confirmation for the Samoa International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External counsel in Apia licensed under the Samoa Law Practitioners Act
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional hourly-block benchmark for offshore corporate counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier for apostilled original documents (DHL or FedEx priority service)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DHL, FedEx, or equivalent international courier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Published courier tariff for priority international delivery

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, and the International Companies Regulations 1987, in particular the provisions on incorporation, registered office, registered agent, shares, and directors (IC Act, ss. 4-21)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Companies Office, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form 1) under the International Companies Act 1987, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and Statement of Particulars
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987. The subscribed capital is stated in the Memorandum, commonly USD 1.00 to USD 100.00; no escrow account or capital deposit is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE SOLE SUBSCRIBER AND FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME], an International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa). By unanimous written consent, the subscriber subscribes to 100 ordinary shares at USD 1.00 par value each. The board adopts the registered office in the Statement of Particulars; appoints [NAME] as President/CEO, [NAME] as Secretary, and [NAME] as Treasurer; authorizes opening a bank account at a licensed international bank with signatories per the mandate; and authorizes officers to execute all filings needed to maintain good standing. Effective on [DATE].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage a Licensed Samoan Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent approved by the Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The proposed International Company must appoint a registered agent licensed under the International Companies Act 1987 to act as statutory local agent and registered office holder. Execute the engagement letter and complete all KYC, AML, and beneficial-ownership identification procedures before filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name and business purpose
Passport copy of each shareholder and director
Proof of residential address of each beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the selected agent declines engagement, appoint another licensed agent; no government remedy is required at this pre-filing stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve Company Name and Conduct Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed company names in the required format, each ending with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd' or a recognized equivalent, together with a short statement of the principal business purpose. The Registrar will check the names against the registered companies index and reserve an available name.
required_dossiers: List of proposed company names in priority order
Brief description of the principal international business activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If all proposed names are conflicting or misleading, submit a fresh list of alternative names or file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft, Execute and Notarize Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and notarial officer recognized under Samoan law
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, Statement of Particulars, and consents to act for directors and officers. Execute the documents before a notary public or under the registered agent's authorized procedure and affix any required company seal.
required_dossiers: Statement of Particulars setting out registered office, registered agent, directors and officers
Consent to act from each director and officer
Power of attorney where a subscriber signs through an attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or registered agent raises a correction, re-execute with approved attestation wording; re-notarization within the same filing does not require a further Registry fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation Application and Pay Government Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed incorporation application form to the Registrar through the registered agent, together with the executed constitutional documents, statutory declaration of compliance, and the official government filing fee. The filing may be delivered in person at the Companies Office or submitted electronically through the approved agent channel.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of compliance signed by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, respond within 30 calendar days with the requested correction; if the application is rejected, cure the stated defect, amend the constitutional documents, and resubmit with a fresh statutory declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Registrar approves the application, the Certificate of Incorporation is issued. Verify the company name, registration number, incorporation date, registered office and any special conditions shown on the certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical or clerical error, request administrative rectification from the Registrar; the correction is ministerial and does not require re-incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convene First Board Meeting and Issue Share Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Samoa International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or sign a unanimous written resolution to issue the subscriber shares, adopt the registered office, appoint the president, secretary and treasurer, approve bank account opening, and adopt the company seal and share certificates. Record all actions in the statutory minute book.
required_dossiers: Signed board resolution or written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director dissents, convene a physical board meeting on 48 hours' notice; an ordinary majority resolution is sufficient unless the Articles require a higher majority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete Good Standing, Tax Exemption and Physical Clearance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies (MCIL); Samoa International Financial Services Authority; MCIL Business Licence Division; Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual fee and any required exemption confirmation to maintain the International Company's good standing. For a physical office in Samoa, obtain a Business Occupation Licence, fire safety inspection, structural occupancy approval, and workplace registration; for a wholly offshore digital operation, record the statutory exemption and retain supporting evidence.
required_dossiers: Tax exemption or good standing certificate
Business Occupation Licence application (if physical presence in Samoa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a local clearance is delayed, issue a written follow-up and escalate to the MCIL Business Licence Division; a temporary occupation certificate may be requested while final fire safety documentation is being processed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Business Licence Division, Samoa; environmental matters: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Occupation Licence under the Business Licence Act 2011 (Samoa), with International Company Exemption Endorsement where operations are conducted wholly offshore

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / low-impact registration; no full EIA Report required for a remote BPO call center with no manufacturing, fuel combustion, wastewater discharge or hazardous waste generation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to pure office-based operations. If backup diesel generators, cooling towers or HVAC systems are installed, comply with MNRE noise and air-emission limits, proper refrigerant disposal, and e-waste management under the Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority; structural load and building occupancy approval from the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA); workplace health and safety clearance through the Ministry of Labour, including employee injury compensation registration.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue (MoR), Government of Samoa, Apia — official web portal at www.revenue.gov.ws; e-filing, TIN registration and VAT returns are transacted through the Mini-MOR online portal operated by the Commissioner of Revenue under the Tax Administration Act 2015.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident-owned Samoa International Company (IC): (1) a licensed registered agent incorporates the IC with the Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) under the International Companies Act 1987 and obtains the Certificate of Incorporation, constitution and registered office; (2) the agent submits the SIFSA incorporation pack plus the TIN application (Form TIN-01, with passport copies and proof of address for shareholders and directors) to the Ministry of Revenue via the Mini-MOR portal or in person; (3) the Commissioner registers the IC and issues a Tax Identification Number (TIN), and, where the IC elects voluntary VAT registration for zero-rating of offshore services, a VAT registration certificate; (4) the foreign IC is not required to maintain a physical office, appoint local directors, or file Samoa tax returns for exempt income, but must keep its SIFSA license current and inform MoR of changes to registered agent, registered office, name or structure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: the Samoa IC is an entity-level legal person under the International Companies Act 1987, but for income tax and VAT purposes it is a statutorily exempt person — while it does not carry on business in Samoa it is outside the 27% corporate income tax, outside VAT on offshore receipts, and free of dividend/interest/royalty withholding taxes and stamp duty. The classification is territorial: any Samoa-sourced trading, local payroll for Samoa-resident call center agents, or supply to a Samoa-resident buyer in the BPO value chain re-subjects the IC to full Samoa taxation. Pass-through treatment is not available; shareholders are treated as separate persons.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in Samoa. The relevant statutory elections are: (1) International Companies Act 1987 conversion election — an IC may elect, by special resolution, to convert to a domestic company (opting into Samoa tax) and a domestic company may elect to convert into an IC (acquiring tax-exempt status), both subject to SIFSA approval; (2) Income Tax Act 2015 election for resident entities to be treated as fiscally transparent partnerships or trusts where the arrangement is genuine and the Commissioner consents; (3) elective voluntary VAT registration for offshore service providers below the SAT 100,000 threshold, which is the operative election used by remote BPO ICs to access zero-rating; (4) no hybrid mismatch election is available to ICs, and Samoa CFC/transfer-pricing rules apply only to Samoan-resident shareholders or connected domestic parties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act 2021 (in force 1 October 2021), successor to the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2008 (VAGST); VAT applies to taxable supplies made in Samoa by registered persons and to imports, and is governed administratively by the Tax Administration Act 2015.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 100,000 of taxable supplies in any 12-month period (Samoan tala); mandatory registration for persons making or intending to make taxable supplies above SAT 100,000 in Samoa, voluntary registration below the threshold; an offshore BPO IC whose call-center and tele-sales services are performed for and consumed by non-residents has no Samoa taxable supply nexus and is not registrable except by voluntary election.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time continuous-control e-invoicing or digital fiscal stamping mandate exists in Samoa as of the 2025 tax year. The binding requirements are: (i) registration, return filing and payment via the Mini-MOR e-government portal; (ii) issuance of a statutory tax invoice (supplier and recipient TINs, invoice date/number, description, VAT-exclusive price, VAT or 0% rate, and VAT amount); (iii) retention of underlying electronic records, CDR logs and bank remittance evidence for audit; and (iv) customs electronic export declarations via ASYCUDA World where physical goods movement is involved. The Minister of Revenue may by notice mandate certified digital invoicing or a clearance/authorization process for specific sectors, but none has been gazetted for the offshore BPO industry.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: VAT zero-rating applies to: (a) goods physically exported from Samoa under customs control; and (b) services supplied to a recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and not present in Samoa when the service is performed (international/offshore services), including remote multilingual inbound helpdesk and outbound tele-sales rendered by a Samoa IC to foreign principals under a cross-border BPO agreement. Eligibility conditions: the IC must be a VAT-registered person (or elect voluntary registration), must invoice at 0%, must contract, deliver and invoice in a foreign currency, must evidence that the service is not for consumption in Samoa, and must repatriate the foreign-currency consideration within the statutory period; services consumed by a Samoa-resident entity, call monitoring performed on behalf of a domestic client, or agent payroll sourced inside Samoa will taint the zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic export lodgment and customs endorsement) for any physical deliverables, media or equipment accompanying the services
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill evidencing shipment from a Samoa port or airport to the foreign buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT MT103 evidencing receipt of foreign-currency export proceeds
Master Services Agreement, work orders and call detail records (CDRs) demonstrating that the helpdesk/tele-sales service was performed for and delivered to the non-resident principal
Zero-rated tax invoices and a supplier export register reconciling each invoice to its dispatch, performance and remittance documentation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Commissioner may verify zero-rated claims against ASYCUDA export records, bank statements, customs exit confirmations, subscriber CDRs and the BPO agent payroll. Failure to substantiate export/offshore status or to repatriate proceeds within 180 days reverses the 0% rate to 15% VAT; the resulting VAT shortfall attracts statutory interest plus a shortfall penalty of 50% of the tax avoided (20% where the failure was negligent and not intentional or reckless), and a 100% evasion penalty with criminal prosecution where fraud or deliberate falsification is established: on conviction a body corporate is liable to a fine up to SAT 200,000 and an individual to a fine up to SAT 100,000 or imprisonment up to two years, or both. Retrospective clawbacks can extend to net input VAT refunds previously paid and, for an IC, may trigger SIFSA decertification and loss of the International Company tax exemption where the audit establishes that an unapproved domestic activity was carried on.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), Falepuna, Apia, established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984. CBS is the Exchange Control Administrator under the Exchange Control Act 1976 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1977, and is the licensing and AML/CFT supervisor under the Financial Institutions Act 1996 and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2007 (as amended). Corporate registration of the International Company (IC) is administered by the Registrar of International Companies within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour under the International Companies Act 1987 (ICA 1987).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is convertible for current-account transactions but is not freely deliverable offshore; resident capital-account transfers require CBS approval or execution through an authorized dealer. An International Company is a non-resident statutory construct: it must transact exclusively in foreign currency with non-resident counterparties and is effectively outside the CBS surrender and approval regime for offshore transactions. Dividend, capital, and profit repatriation from the IC's foreign-currency account is unrestricted provided the funds remain offshore; the practical hurdle is WST conversion for local statutory costs (registered agent, government fees, audit), which must be executed through a Samoan authorized dealer. The IC must not derive WST revenue from Samoan residents or it risks losing its non-resident status and triggering full exchange-control obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident exporters under the Exchange Control Regulations, export proceeds must be received within six months of the date of export (services: within six months of the invoice date), and 100% of the foreign currency received must be offered for sale to an authorized dealer within two months of receipt, unless the CBS has approved a foreign-currency retention limit. Offshore International Companies are statutorily exempt from the surrender regime in respect of foreign-currency transactions with non-residents; therefore, BPO service fees invoiced in USD to offshore clients may be retained, not converted into WST, and may be freely deployed for offshore payroll and vendor settlements, provided the underlying contracts are with non-residents and the receipts are credited to the IC's designated USD account at a licensed Samoan bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account — USD-denominated non-resident IC; Capital Escrow sub-account available on request
Operational Account — USD-denominated non-resident IC; Capital Escrow sub-account available on request
Operational Account — USD/WST corporate; limited escrow and international payment capability
Domestic WST Account only — not suitable for the IC's foreign-currency treasury

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for the Samoa-incorporated IC itself. Samoa has no digital-EMI or e-money licensing regime, and fintech platforms including Wise Business do not accept companies incorporated in Samoa as accountholders. The target rail 'Wise_B2B' is viable only as an inbound collection channel: BPO clients can initiate Wise payments to the IC's USD account at a Samoan bank using a unique payment reference. Outbound Wise/B2B disbursement capability would require a separately incorporated operating or treasury entity in a supported jurisdiction (e.g., New Zealand or Hong Kong), which introduces substance, transfer-pricing, and exchange-control exposure unless the Samoa IC is properly remunerated at arm's length with full intercompany documentation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is the default rule. The initial account-opening interview for a non-resident IC requires at least one authorized signatory director and, for nominee or trust ownership, the ultimate beneficial owner or a fully identified fiduciary to appear in person at the bank's Apia office. ANZ Samoa may waive travel through ANZ Group cross-border onboarding (identity verification at an ANZ branch in the UBO's country plus live video interview) at the account owner's cost. Remote-only opening is not generally available; for a purely Chinese-owned, low-risk BPO vehicle, banks may accept a registered-agent-certified KYC pack with a notarized board resolution, passport and PRC identity copies, a bank reference from the UBO's home bank, and the PRC beneficial-ownership filing receipt, subject to live video verification. A two-business-day physical visit to Apia by a single director holding a power of attorney for all directors is the recommended plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholder or discretionary trust concealing the natural-person Ultimate Beneficial Owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered agent's CDD file; trust deed or authenticated extract identifying settlor, protector, and beneficiary class; protector's written consent; statutory beneficial-ownership register; full corporate genealogy chart tracing control to all 25%+ natural persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-funds and high-risk jurisdiction qualifier, particularly PRC-sourced capital for family-trust origins.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO passport and PRC resident ID; China Beneficial Ownership Information filing receipt under the 1 November 2024 filing regime; sworn source-of-wealth statement; tax returns or asset sale/transfer contracts supporting the capital; bank letter of comfort from the UBO's home institution; family-office attestation of trust corpus.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through typology: rapid inflow of BPO revenues followed by same-day outbound salary payments to third-country agents in China, the Philippines, or India.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed BPO master services agreements with each client; invoice schedule with unique payment references; payroll register per remote agent with contractor agreements; 12-month cash-flow forecast; board minutes approving the treasury policy; covenant to maintain a minimum operating balance (e.g., USD 50,000).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of economic substance in Samoa (no office, staff, or board activity).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office and licensed registered agent confirmation; annual returns and share register; board meeting minutes held in Apia; economic substance declaration or filing with staffing and expenditure records for the Samoan representative office; independent accountant's letter confirming the IC's non-resident status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP screening ambiguity on new counterparties, including sanctioned or high-risk Chinese entities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete counterparty due diligence: licenses, UBO attestations, and bank references from each BPO client; confirmation that no sanctioned persons appear after the bank's screening; contractual anti-sanctions and non-assignment clauses; demonstrated SWIFT purpose-code transparency for all outbound payments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's bank to the IC's USD account at ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa; Wise B2B may be used if the subscribing shareholder is based in a Wise-supported jurisdiction. Payment fields: Field 23E 'INSD' and Field 70 must read '//INV/' followed by 'Share capital subscription of [N] shares per Board Resolution dated [DDMMMYYYY]', or '//INTC/' for a shareholder loan. Purpose codes: CAPT for capital injection; INTC for intercompany loan. No CBS approval is required for a foreign-currency credit to the IC's non-resident account, but the bank's compliance pack must include the board resolution, return of allotment filed with the Registrar of International Companies, updated share register, and a source-of-funds declaration for amounts above USD 100,000. If the share subscription is conditional, a ring-fenced escrow sub-account is opened within the same corporate mandate and released only upon completion evidence approved by the registered agent and the bank's compliance officer; WST conversion must be avoided at all inbound stages to preserve the IC's non-resident status.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 single or batch transfers from the IC's USD account for payroll, vendor, and intra-group settlements, using purpose codes SALA, SERV, INTC, or ITDS, with full beneficiary bank BIC and the IC's unique payment reference; (b) SWIFT MT700/MT710 documentary letter of credit (UCP600) with an advising or confirming bank in the US or EU for hardware or infrastructure procurement, requiring collateral or audited financials from the IC; (c) WST spot conversion solely for local statutory costs such as registered-agent fees, MCIL annual fees, and auditor fees; and (d) Wise B2B used only by the IC's clients for inbound invoice settlement, not by the IC for outbound disbursements. For payments to PRC beneficiaries, the remittance must carry a full purpose description enabling the Chinese receiving bank to file current-account receipts under PBOC/SAFE rules; each PRC staff member must retain payroll evidence and comply with annual USD settlement limits and individual income tax filings. The IC must not disburse to Samoan residents for any goods or services other than permissible office, professional, and compliance costs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/WST outright forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months, underlying committed WST expense) executed with an authorized dealer.
Non-deliverable USD/WST forwards (offshore NDF) transacted by a non-deliverable desk to hedge the IC's WST budget exposure without physical Tala delivery.
Plain-vanilla cross-currency USD/WST swaps for matched asset-liability or shareholder-loan hedging, subject to CBS notification if executed onshore.
FX spot purchase (T+2) of WST for registered-agent, regulatory, and audit fees only.
Barrier and exotic options generally prohibited; any option requires prior CBS authorization and a documented hedging requirement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Aggregate Sectors and Extended Annual Licence Scheduling
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 31 March of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts a monthly default fine of 2% of the fee until settled; continued non-payment for 60 days results in suspension of the operating license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Entities with annual turnover exceeding USD 150,000 are required to file independently audited financial statements. Exempt entities must submit a signed accountant's review report.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS for Companies legislation as adopted by the National Accounting Standards Board; local GAAP permitted for small enterprises.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Confirmation statement must be filed annually with the Companies Registry confirming the register of members, directors, and beneficial owners is accurate. Share transfer notifications must be reported within 14 days of the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 to USD 850 depending on the service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 to USD 3,500 depending on volume and complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (standard resident company rate under the Income Tax Act 2015 (Samoa), as amended)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for Samoa International Companies (IC). Section 194 of the International Companies Act 1987 grants a full statutory exemption from income tax, stamp duty and exchange control on all offshore-sourced profits, provided the IC does not derive income from sources within Samoa and does not carry on business with Samoan residents. Remote BPO helpdesk fees billed abroad and booked through an Apia-registered IC are therefore exempt.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Company Income Tax Return — Ministry of Revenue Form IR-2; lodgement via the Ministry of Revenue e-Services portal (paper lodgement at the Income Tax Division, Apia).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year is the calendar year (1 January – 31 December); the annual return and final payment are due on or before 30 April of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross business and trading income from all sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident IC: leave nil; offshore BPO invoices are outside Samoa-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income (International Company exemption, diplomatic, etc.)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the full value of offshore contract revenue claimed as exempt under the International Companies Act 1987.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable business deductions (staff, telecoms, software, rent, agent fees)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs generally do not complete the deduction schedule because exempt income requires no netting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable income (Box 1a minus Box 3), after loss carry-forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil for an exempt IC; a positive figure exposes the IC to Samoan CIT and forfeiture of IC status.
Nil; a positive assessment here is a fatal red flag for IC non-resident status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits and withholding credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claimable only where the IC has been accidentally taxed at source in a client jurisdiction.
For ICs: zero tax payable; attach the exemption certificate issued by the Registrar of International Companies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: penalty of 5% of tax payable per month or part thereof (capped at 25%) plus late-payment interest at 10% per annum; failure to keep records: fine up to WST 10,000; deliberate understatement: uplift of 50% of the shortfall and prosecution risk.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Declaration and Renewal — Registrar of International Companies (online submission via the licensed registered agent; fee paid to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing due no later than 30 days following each anniversary of incorporation; the government annual license fee (calculated on authorised capital) is payable with the declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent and registered office details in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All ICs must maintain a licensed registered agent and a registered office in Apia.
Nominee directors are permitted; beneficial owner details held by the agent for AML purposes.
State: 'offshore multilingual BPO call center and customer helpdesk (ISIC 7820)'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that no business is conducted within Samoa and no property in Samoa is held
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be certified by the registered agent; breach voids the tax exemption retroactively.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal: automatic 10% surcharge on the annual fee; continued non-renewal: strike-off and deregistration of the IC; the former directors remain liable for debts and any tax that crystallises on deregistration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% final withholding tax on dividends paid by a resident Samoan company to non-resident shareholders (Income Tax Act 2015). International Companies: 0% — distributions by an exempt IC to non-resident shareholders are outside the Samoan WHT net.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa maintains a limited DTA network (principally Australia and New Zealand). To invoke treaty relief the beneficial owner must: (i) obtain a Certificate of Residence from the Ministry of Revenue (TRC application with the IC's incorporation certificate and agent letter); (ii) submit a completed treaty relief claim form to the withholding agent before payment; and (iii) keep the TRC valid for the whole income year. The payer must retain the TRC copy for 5 years or be exposed to the full 15% withholding plus penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and interest: 15% statutory final withholding on payments by a Samoan resident payer to a non-resident; DTA-reduced rates of 10% (Australia/NZ arm's length flow) where conditions are met. For a Samoa IC licensing software or receiving client fees in its own name, the exemption applies and no Samoan WHT arises on onward royalty streams.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 2,000,000 aggregate related-party transactions in a tax year (advisory threshold; Samoa has no formal Local File / Master File legislation, but the Income Tax Act 2015 arm's length rule and the OECD TP Guidelines are applied on audit; ICs with exclusively offshore-sourced income are outside the documentation obligation)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa does not maintain standalone Economic Substance Regulations. Substance is nevertheless required to preserve the IC exemption and treaty access: (i) a licensed registered agent and Apia registered office (ICA 1987); (ii) board meetings or written resolutions minuted in Samoa; (iii) local accounting records reflecting the BPO's real staffing, billing and client contracts; and (iv) genuine offshore management. A pure booking-company structure with zero employees and no governance will be treated as a sham and reclassified as resident, exposing all profits to 27% CIT.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion — Income Tax Act 2015 & Tax Administration Act 2012
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly understating or concealing income, fabricating exempt offshore revenue, or using the IC to invoice Samoan-resident clients in breach of the international company exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of up to 200% of the evaded tax, 50% uplift for deliberate misstatement, interest at 10% per annum, and criminal fine not exceeding WST 100,000; imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil-piercing: directors who signed false returns are personally and jointly liable for the underpaid tax; travel objection notices may be issued preventing departure from Samoa until a tax clearance certificate is settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Arrangement under International Companies Act 1987
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a façade — no registered agent, no Apia registered office, nominee-only governance, no payroll or operational substance behind the remote BPO contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and deregistration by the Registrar, fine up to WST 20,000, and loss of the ICA tax exemption with retroactive 27% CIT on accumulated profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are liable for the company's unpaid taxes and third-party debts if the IC was a mere façade; disqualification from managing a company for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach — Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) and UBO Filing Obligations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing inbound BPO client payments (Wise B2B, SWIFT wire transfers) without customer due diligence, enhanced CDD on high-risk counterparties, or filing of suspicious transaction reports; concealment of the beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WST 500,000 per breach for the company; the responsible officer faces a further fine up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; freezing of funds and revocation of the registered agent licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally indictable where wilful blindness or laundering of proceeds through the BPO payment rails is proven; civil confiscation and asset forfeiture apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Profiteering from Tax Havens — Treaty Override and Beneficial Ownership Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Interposing the Samoa IC solely to route client fees or royalties and claiming foreign treaty benefits without economic substance, or repatriating profits by way of inflated royalty/interest payments to connected parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of treaty relief and WHT exemption; recharacterisation of payments as taxable dividends at 15% WHT plus penalties of 25% and interest at 10% per annum.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who structured the conduit arrangements face personal assessment for unpaid WHT, breach of directors' duties claims by creditors, and civil restitution orders.
